analysis: The PR only changes docs/developer/test.md. It adds a 'Deadline Admission Estimators' section (head lines 113-137) that documents test selectors: EngineMeasurementOrderingTests, AdmissionRateEstimatorTests and the SDK CBv2PerBatchDecode suites. No executable code, protocol handling, authorization, attestation, key custody, encryption or billing logic changes. The new text states the tests use scripted engines and synthetic usage, load no model or GPU, and do not qualify live refusal rates, hardware performance or routing. That is consistent with the threat model's stance that synthetic tests are not production qualification (TB-011, T-053, T-056). It adds no commands touching production, credentials or running provider state. The commands are local swift test invocations. Nothing in the diff weakens or contradicts TB-002 or TB-011 gates or the final-handoff authorization. Remaining uncertainty: the diff cannot show whether the referenced test suites and admission-estimator code exist or behave as described. That code is outside the supplied evidence, so the documentation's accuracy and any security impact of the underlying estimator changes belong to a review of those source files. No threat-model update is needed for this documentation-only change.
